# @boostengine/collections

> Universal API Collections & Tooling engine for Indian + Global e-commerce APIs (Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, Paytm, Stripe, Shiprocket, Delhivery, EasyEcom, Shopify). Ships production-ready Postman collections, OpenAPI/Bruno converters, a cURL & code-snippet generator, a lightweight runner, and an AI Agent Toolkit (OpenAI / Anthropic / MCP).

## Collections

- `razorpay` — payments — basic auth — 31 endpoints
- `cashfree` — payments — apikey — 27 endpoints
- `phonepe` — payments — hmac — 7 endpoints
- `paytm` — payments — hmac — 5 endpoints
- `stripe` — payments — bearer — 10 endpoints
- `easyecom` — wms — bearer — 12 endpoints
- `shiprocket` — logistics — bearer — 19 endpoints
- `delhivery` — logistics — apikey — 10 endpoints
- `shopify` — platform — apikey — 12 endpoints

## Core API

- `listCollections()` — summaries with endpoint counts, folders, categories, auth scheme.
- `getCollection(name)` / `getEnvironment(name)` — type-safe Postman v2.1.0 getters.
- `findEndpoints({ provider, method, path, tag })` — filter endpoints across collections.
- `interpolateVariables(request, environment)` — resolve `{{var}}` placeholders.
- `generateCurl(request, environment?)` — clean, executable cURL.
- `generateCodeSnippet(request, environment?, target)` — `fetch` | `axios` | `node-https`.
- `exportToOpenAPI(name)` — Postman → OpenAPI 3.0 JSON.
- `exportToBruno(name)` — Postman → Bruno collection.
- `exportToDirectory(name, dir, format)` — `postman` | `openapi` | `bruno`.
- `runCollection(name, { env, baseUrl, onProgress, dryRun })` — in-memory mock runner.

## AI Toolkit (`@boostengine/collections/ai`)

- `collectionTools` — OpenAI function-calling schemas.
- `anthropicTools` — Anthropic `input_schema` schemas.
- `mcpTools` — MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool definitions.
- `executeCollectionTool(name, args)` — runtime dispatcher.
- `getCollectionSystemPrompt(provider)` — LLM context for a provider.

## Quick Start

```ts
import { listCollections, generateCurl, exportToOpenAPI } from '@boostengine/collections';
import { collectionTools } from '@boostengine/collections/ai';
```
